claims.claim: bounds.gms is included in the bounds phase when damages=KotzWenz
The switch is damages=KotzWenz, located in modules/50_damages/module.gms
claims.note: The switch is set in main.gms:438 (`$setGlobal damages off`, def = off), not in module.gms. The answer also never says the module is off by default.
cm_damage_KWSE exists (a standard-error setting for Kalkuhl & Wenz damages) and does not control this file.

claims.claim: KotzWenzItr is a realization of module 51_internalizeDamages, used when damages are internalized

claims.note: It fixes vm_damageProdFactor=1 and vm_damageFactor=pm_damage for ttot>=cm_startyear as bounds before each solve, and pm_damage is updated between iterations. 'Post-hoc' is loose wording.

claims.claim: The RIKEN config rows M-SSP2-NPi-KLW (internalize off), VLLO-SSP2-KLW and VLLO-SSP1-KLW (internalize KotzWenzItr) set damages=KotzWenz
The VLLO-*-KLW runs don't hit bounds.gms; only M-SSP2-NPi-KLW exercises it, because 51_internalizeDamages/KotzWenzItr handles damages instead
claims.note: The include depends only on damages=KotzWenz, so bounds.gms is active in all three runs. KotzWenzItr adds the damage internalization (social cost of carbon, SCC) on top. It does not replace or override the fixing of vm_damageFactor, and it never touches these variables. The answer's final conclusion wrongly excludes two of the three scenarios.

grade.went_well: It named the correct realization and phase include and the correct content of bounds.gms. It found the right config file and all three KLW rows with the correct internalizeDamages values, and it placed KotzWenzItr in module 51 correctly.
grade.answer_key_issues: The answer key is consistent with the code. As a small addition, config/scenario_config_magpie_RIKEN.csv also contains rows with the same KLW names (lines 5-7). Those rows hold only MAgPIE settings and no damages column, so the key's 'only scenario_config_RIKEN.csv' holds for the REMIND switch.
grade.summary: The answer finds the correct switch, the file contents and the three RIKEN KLW scenarios. It then wrongly concludes that the two VLLO-*-KLW runs (internalizeDamages=KotzWenzItr) don't use 50_damages/KotzWenz/bounds.gms. That file is included whenever damages=KotzWenz, whatever module 51 is set to, and KotzWenzItr never touches vm_damageFactor. It also puts the switch in module.gms instead of main.gms:438 and never states that damages is off by default.
